from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    # The solid one-color column separates two noisy binary panels.
    sep = next(c for c in range(len(grid[0]))
               if len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1)
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep+1:] for row in grid]
    left_bg = Counter(v for row in left for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    right_bg = Counter(v for row in right for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[3 if left[r][c] != left_bg and right[r][c] == right_bg else right_bg
             for c in range(len(right[0]))] for r in range(len(grid))]

if __name__ == '__main__':
